documents.title: Search Ranking Algorithm Overview
documents.body: This document describes how the internal search service ranks results. We build a bag-of-words vector for each document and for the query, then rank by cosine similarity. Term frequency is computed per document without any external library.

documents.title: Annual Finance Budget Summary
documents.body: Summary of the annual finance budget across all departments. Includes headcount costs, infrastructure spend, and a comparison against the prior year budget allocation.

documents.title: Onboarding Guide for New Engineers
documents.body: A step by step onboarding guide for new engineers joining the platform team. Covers repository access, local development setup, and where to find the search service architecture docs.

documents.title: Q4 Finance Close Checklist
documents.body: Checklist for closing the finance books at the end of Q4. Includes reconciling vendor invoices, accruals, and final budget variance reporting for finance leadership.

documents.title: Search Index Sharding Strategy
documents.body: Proposes a sharding strategy for the search index as the document count grows. Discusses partitioning by owner and by creation date, and the tradeoffs for ranking across shards.

documents.title: Q4 Product Roadmap
documents.body: Product roadmap for Q4 covering the search relevance improvements, a new tagging system for documents, and planned API changes for external partners.

documents.title: Incident Postmortem: Search Latency Spike
documents.body: Postmortem for a search latency spike caused by an unbounded ranking query. Root cause was a missing limit on the number of documents scored per request. Includes remediation steps.

documents.title: API Design Guidelines
documents.body: Internal guidelines for designing HTTP APIs, including how to handle query parameters, pagination with limit and offset, and sensible defaults for malformed input.

documents.title: Database Schema Review Notes
documents.body: Notes from a schema review for the documents table. Discusses normalizing tags into a join table versus storing them as an array column, and the impact on query performance.

documents.title: Finance Vendor Payment Policy
documents.body: Policy document describing how vendor payments are approved and processed by the finance team, including thresholds that require director sign off.

documents.title: Frontend Component Library Spec
documents.body: Specification for the shared frontend component library used by the internal tools team, including the search bar component and result list rendering.

documents.title: Security Audit Findings Q3
documents.body: Findings from the Q3 security audit of internal services, including the search API. No critical findings; two medium severity issues related to rate limiting were logged.

documents.title: Q4 Sales Playbook
documents.body: Sales playbook for Q4 covering the updated pricing tiers, objection handling scripts, and how to demo the new document search feature to prospective customers.

documents.title: Marketing Campaign Retrospective
documents.body: Retrospective on the most recent marketing campaign, reviewing signup conversion rates and which channels drove the most qualified leads.

documents.title: Q4 Finance Forecast Review
documents.body: Review of the Q4 finance forecast against actuals, with commentary from finance leadership on where spend is tracking above or below plan.

documents.title: Legal Compliance Checklist
documents.body: Checklist used by the legal team to confirm compliance requirements are met before a new feature, such as document search, is released to customers.

documents.title: Finance Expense Reimbursement Policy
documents.body: Policy for submitting and approving employee expense reimbursements, including travel, software subscriptions, and equipment purchases.

documents.title: Backend Service Migration Plan
documents.body: Plan for migrating the backend document storage service to a new database cluster with minimal downtime for the search API.

documents.title: Customer Onboarding Playbook
documents.body: Playbook for onboarding new customers to the platform, including how to import their first batch of documents and configure search permissions.

documents.title: Search Relevance Tuning Notes
documents.body: Notes on tuning search relevance, including experiments with term weighting and why cosine similarity was chosen over a raw dot product for ranking documents.

documents.body: Runbook for responding to a security incident affecting internal services, including escalation contacts and how to rotate credentials for the search API.

documents.title: Product Roadmap Planning Q1

documents.body: Hiring plan for Q4, outlining open engineering and sales headcount, and the interview process for candidates applying to the platform team.

documents.body: Describes the finance quarterly close process end to end, from initial reconciliation through final sign off by the finance director.
